nodes.label: Dynamic ABAC policy DSL + evaluator
nodes.rationale: Versioned jsonb condition AST over a closed server-side attribute allow-list; no eval/new Function; fail-closed; only is_dsl_managed rows are evaluated to avoid a full-tenant lockout; explicit DENY wins before the RBAC check.

nodes.label: Business-scope hierarchy authorization layer
nodes.rationale: Generic scope_type/scope_id references resolved by a provider-supplied resolver; base ships a fail-closed NO-OP resolver so scope-gated high-risk actions deny by default.

nodes.label: Segregation-of-duties (SoD) conflict detection and enforcement
nodes.rationale: Base ships no domain SoD rules; rules are contributed by domain modules. Action-time fail-closed enforcement (deny-overrides-allow) with a scope/time-bound, non-self-approvable exception flow.

nodes.label: MFA TOTP, recovery codes, step-up, session assurance (aal1/aal2)
nodes.rationale: Encrypted-at-rest TOTP; no account-enumeration oracle; enforcement driven by DB factor/enrollment state (fail-closed, self-recoverable) rather than a deployment-wide flag.
nodes.norm_label: mfa totp, recovery codes, step-up, session assurance (aal1/aal2)

nodes.label: Tenant-aware OIDC/SSO with account linking + break-glass
nodes.rationale: Mints an opaque awcms session (never uses the ID token as the app session); SSRF guard blocks private/metadata IPs (reversing mini's no-block posture); auth-code+PKCE+state+nonce; break-glass prevents password-login lockout.
nodes.norm_label: tenant-aware oidc/sso with account linking + break-glass

nodes.label: Deployment-profile-aware Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection
nodes.rationale: Retains a full-online deployment-profile gate (LAN/offline exempt) — the one full-online gate MFA/OIDC deliberately dropped; verifier runs outside any DB transaction, fails closed with a generic error.

nodes.label: Sync HMAC v2 signatures (tenant+node bound)
nodes.rationale: v2 material v2:<tenantId>:<nodeCode>:<timestamp>:<body> (tenantId constrained to UUID to remove delimiter ambiguity) closes cross-tenant sync forgery (GHSA-c972-3q5p-g3h4); nodes auto-register inactive.

nodes.label: Audit log retention purge job
nodes.rationale: AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS made real: bounded-batch delete of awcms_audit_events, self-auditing each purge; awcms_abac_decision_logs deliberately untouched.

nodes.label: Least-privilege runtime DB roles (awcms_app/worker/setup)
nodes.rationale: Non-superuser, NOBYPASSRLS, non-owner roles make RLS a real boundary; fail-closed all-zero app.current_tenant_id default; opt-in worker/setup role split.

nodes.label: FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY enforcement
nodes.rationale: 23 tenant-scoped tables only ENABLE'd RLS (ignored for the table owner); migration 017 adds FORCE, and security:readiness catches inert RLS / RLS-bypassing roles.

nodes.label: Module composition validation engine (base registry)
nodes.rationale: The derived-application composition seam was fully removed in v6.0.0 (ADR-0034 Fase 2); module-composition now validates a single base registry (DAG, duplicate key, capability binding, deployment profile, navigation, job descriptor).

nodes.label: Shared keyset pagination (full-microsecond cursor)
nodes.rationale: Cursor carries created_at at full microsecond precision to avoid silent row loss at millisecond page boundaries.

nodes.label: ADR-based decision-making process
nodes.rationale: Standard changes require an ADR approved by >=2 maintainers when available; ADRs are never deleted, only marked Superseded.

nodes.label: Intentional divergences allow-list (reason/owner/reviewDate/ADR)
nodes.rationale: Each divergence from the awcms-mini standard must stay justified; the gate fails once a reviewDate is past or a backing ADR file is missing.

nodes.label: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform
nodes.rationale: Existing tech foundation (RLS, ABAC, offline-first, contracts) is proven; one repo/one standard reduces cross-repo coordination. Point 3 amended by ADR-0022, later superseded by ADR-0034.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0001 rebuild awcms as erp modular-monolith platform
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0002 Bun-only runtime & tooling
nodes.rationale: Two runtimes add behavioral branching, toolchain size, and bug surface; Bun provides runtime, package manager, test runner, and built-in APIs sufficient for the base.
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0003 PostgreSQL + RLS multi-tenant isolation
nodes.rationale: App-level tenant_id filtering alone is fragile; RLS FORCE + non-superuser role gives defense-in-depth so one forgotten filter cannot leak cross-tenant data.
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: SECURITY DEFINER bootstrap-read checklist (ADR-0003)
nodes.rationale: Pre-tenant-context lookups (hostname/tenantCode -> tenant_id) need SECURITY DEFINER functions; safety comes from correct owner (bootstrap NOLOGIN role) + static SQL + narrow columns + REVOKE from PUBLIC + locked search_path, verified empirically.
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0004 RBAC + ABAC default-deny baseline
nodes.rationale: RBAC alone cannot express attribute-dependent rules (ownership, scope, self-approval); default-deny + deny-overrides-allow keeps access safe-by-default and auditable.
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0005 Soft delete for master/config, immutability for posted data
nodes.rationale: Physical delete destroys audit trail and breaks references; posted/append-only events must not be retroactively edited, corrected via reversal/adjustment rows.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0005 soft delete for master/config, immutability for posted data
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0006 Offline-first + transactional outbox + sync HMAC
nodes.rationale: Critical flows must not depend on internet/providers; outbox written in same tx, external providers never called inside the DB transaction, sync signed with HMAC + anti-replay, conflicts resolved manually.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0006 offline-first + transactional outbox + sync hmac
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0007 OpenAPI & AsyncAPI as mandatory contracts
nodes.rationale: Without explicit contracts, API/events drift across modules and are hard to test; one source of truth for REST and domain events, validated in CI (api:spec:check).
nodes.norm_label: adr-0007 openapi & asyncapi as mandatory contracts
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0008 Independent versioning (package / contract / module descriptor)
nodes.rationale: package.json release version, OpenAPI/AsyncAPI contract version, and module descriptor version have distinct change cadences; mechanically equating them gives false signals.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0008 independent versioning (package / contract / module descriptor)
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0009 Public tenant-scoped routes via path segment
nodes.rationale: Anonymous public routes resolve tenant via explicit /{tenantCode}/ path segment (not subdomain) so it works identically on LAN/offline deployments without wildcard DNS/TLS.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0009 public tenant-scoped routes via path segment
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0010 Host/domain-based public tenant routing (online extension)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in PUBLIC_TENANT_RESOLUTION_MODE=host_default adds clean /news host-resolved routes for online/SaaS deployments as an additive extension on top of ADR-0009, never replacing it; tenant isolation stays purely RLS.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0010 host/domain-based public tenant routing (online extension)
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0011 Capability ports for cross-module collaboration
nodes.rationale: Direct cross-module TS imports created a real source-code cycle between blog_content and news_portal; ports-and-adapters with route-handler composition roots breaks it, verified by tests/unit/module-boundary.test.ts.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0011 capability ports for cross-module collaboration
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0012 Module admission categories & trusted static registry
nodes.rationale: Five admission categories + a trusted static registry; explicit ban on marketplace/plugin upload/dynamic import/eval of tenant-supplied code without a new ADR superseding ADR-0001/0002.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0012 module admission categories & trusted static registry
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0013 Extension layers & tenant/business boundary model
nodes.rationale: Six extension layers over the five admission categories give cross-repo dependency vocabulary; SaaS Control Plane vs ERP Extension data ownership split; no-shared-table-write. Derived-Application layer later superseded by ADR-0034.
nodes.norm_label: adr-0013 extension layers & tenant/business boundary model
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0014 Deterministic build-time module composition
nodes.rationale: composeModuleRegistry merges base + application registries then validates (13 issue types); merge never throws, validation is an explicit CI/test step. Application-registry derived path later superseded by ADR-0034; base composition retained.
nodes.community_name: ADR-0001 Rebuild AWCMS as ERP modular-monolith platform

nodes.label: ADR-0015 Derived-app compatibility manifest & SemVer gates
nodes.rationale: Adds a static compatibility manifest + hand-written SemVer subset + extension:check wired into check/CI/preflight (applying PR #769/#770 wiring lessons). Superseded by ADR-0034 (manifest + extension:check removed).
nodes.norm_label: adr-0015 derived-app compatibility manifest & semver gates

nodes.label: Data Lifecycle module (API surface)
nodes.rationale: HTTP surface deliberately excludes real archive/purge execution (an internal scheduled job); exposes only registry read, legal-hold create/release, read-only dry-run, and run history.

nodes.label: DataLifecycleDescriptor (HighVolumeTableDescriptor)
nodes.rationale: Trusted code-declared metadata from src/modules/_shared/module-contract.ts, never tenant/request-controlled.

nodes.label: DataLifecycleLegalHold
nodes.rationale: A hold overrides ordinary retention/purge and is checked first, unconditionally; create and release are distinct default-deny permissions (maker/checker).

nodes.label: Domain event outbox + dead-letter replay
nodes.rationale: Consumers deliver redacted payload projections; dead_letter is the DLQ view; replay is permission-gated, reason-required, idempotent, audited.

nodes.label: Email module (API surface)
nodes.rationale: Two-tier ABAC (notification.create for all, announcement.create for role/tenant targets); truncated response means partial send that must be re-targeted.

nodes.label: Foundation module (health/pool probes)
nodes.rationale: Unauthenticated liveness and DB pool/work-class/circuit-breaker health that never exposes tenant data.

nodes.label: ABAC evaluateAccess (access decision engine)
nodes.rationale: Default-deny, deny-overrides-allow cross-module evaluator; DSL policies validated fail-closed before any write; decisions recorded to the ABAC decision log.

nodes.label: MFA / TOTP step-up to aal2
nodes.rationale: Enrollment grants, recovery codes, and step-up raise sessions to aal2 for high-risk actions; tenant policy can require MFA.

nodes.label: Segregation-of-duties (SoD) conflicts + exceptions
nodes.rationale: Business-scope assignments and bounded-lifetime SoD exceptions with maker/checker approval; self-grant and self-approval denied.

nodes.label: AuditEvent
nodes.rationale: Tenant-scoped audit trail row (actor, moduleKey, action, resource, severity, correlationId) written by recordAuditEvent across every module.

nodes.label: Media Library module (API surface)
nodes.rationale: ADR-0036 ownership inversion: owns the tenant media registry presigned-upload/finalize/cancel surface (moved out of news-portal) plus the managed-media enforcement switch; keeps the News Media tag deliberately.

nodes.label: NewsMediaObjectItem (media registry object)
nodes.rationale: Object lifecycle pending_upload -> uploaded -> verified -> attached; finalize does a real R2 GET + magic-byte MIME sniff + server-side SHA-256, never a bare HEAD.

nodes.label: Managed-media enforcement (one-way switch, ADR-0036)
nodes.rationale: Enabling forces content media references to resolve to verified same-tenant registry objects; deliberately one-way with no disable counterpart because self-disabling media validation is a confirmed exploit this design prevents.

nodes.label: ModuleSettingsView (generic per-tenant settings)
nodes.rationale: Defaults + tenant override merged into effective settings; secret-shaped keys/values rejected. Reused by other modules under their own permission.

nodes.label: Module catalog / registry sync (code descriptors -> DB)
nodes.rationale: Trusted code descriptors synced into the DB registry; tenant enable/disable is dependency-validated (core modules and active reverse dependencies rejected).
nodes.norm_label: module catalog / registry sync (code descriptors -> db)

nodes.label: News Portal module (API surface)
nodes.rationale: Admin surface for homepage sections and ad placements; every referenced media object must be a verified/attached R2 media object for the tenant.

nodes.label: Profile Identity module (API surface)
nodes.rationale: Person/organization profiles with typed masked identifiers, cross-module entity links, and identifier-based resolution.

nodes.label: Reporting module (management reporting + projections)
nodes.rationale: Reads-across summaries (access-audit, email-health, sync-health, module-usage, tenant-activity) plus idempotent projection rebuild/reconcile and checksum-verified export download.

nodes.label: SEO & Distribution module (API surface)
nodes.rationale: Tenant SEO config, redirect governance, and privacy-minimized 404 telemetry; public discovery routes (robots/sitemap/feeds) are Astro routes, not part of this REST contract.

nodes.label: Frozen open-redirect guard
nodes.rationale: Redirect targets must be a relative same-origin path or an absolute URL to one of the tenant's verified hosts; unsafe/cross-host/protocol-relative/CRLF/loop/over-long-chain targets rejected.

nodes.label: Sync Storage module (API surface)
nodes.rationale: Admin bearer-session views (conflicts/nodes/object-queue) distinct from the machine-to-machine HMAC push/pull/status/objects endpoints.

nodes.label: HMAC-authenticated sync (push/pull/status/objects)
nodes.rationale: syncHmac + tenantHeader security with SyncNodeId/Timestamp/Signature; push is idempotent per batchId, pull is checkpoint-based; a deactivated node is rejected 403 immediately.

nodes.label: Tenant Admin module (offices/settings/setup)
nodes.rationale: Offices CRUD with soft-delete/restore, tenant settings, and the one-time setup/initialize bootstrap that self-locks.

nodes.label: Tenant Domain module (hostname mappings)
nodes.rationale: Manual-first domain verification and single-primary selection; duplicate hostname always returns a generic conflict that never reveals cross-tenant ownership.

nodes.label: Theming module (draft/publish/rollback)
nodes.rationale: Data-only theme config validated against a build-time theme descriptor (CSS-injection spine); publish creates immutable versions; token values validated against strict CSS grammars.

nodes.label: Visitor Analytics module (API surface)
nodes.rationale: Public anonymous fire-and-forget beacon (always 202, never leaks tenant existence) plus permission-gated dashboards; raw detail hidden unless the caller holds raw_detail.read.

nodes.label: Workflow Approval module (API surface)
nodes.rationale: Versioned workflow definitions (draft/active/retired), a consolidated approval inbox, quorum-gated task decisions, delegations, and administrative force/reassign recovery; self-approval denied.

nodes.label: scripts/ tooling & ops README
nodes.rationale: Bun-run ops/check scripts adapted from awcms-mini and trimmed to what actually runs on the current foundation; per-module workers deferred until their modules exist.

nodes.label: src/lib shared runtime library README
nodes.rationale: Bun-only, secret-free cross-module helpers (auth, database/pooling, logging, observability, jobs, security) so ERP modules focus on business logic.

nodes.label: withTenant + RLS FORCE tenant isolation
nodes.rationale: withTenant applies work-class gate + circuit breaker in front of the pool then RLS SET LOCAL; the least-privilege awcms_app role (no BYPASSRLS) with a fail-closed zero-UUID tenant GUC is what makes RLS FORCE a real security boundary.

nodes.label: Idempotency-Key mutation dedup (_shared/idempotency.ts)
nodes.rationale: Cross-module primitive that dedups high-risk mutations; reused via a shared awcms_idempotency_keys table so replays return the prior result and key reuse with a different payload returns 409.

nodes.label: Keyset pagination (_shared/keyset-pagination.ts)
nodes.rationale: Opaque-cursor list primitive reused by list endpoints across modules.

nodes.label: Blog Content module README
nodes.rationale: First domain module registered directly in the base; admin CRUD/lifecycle, append-only revisions, public /blog/{tenantCode} and /news routes, and content-quality checklist gating.

nodes.label: Author-own-draft ABAC ownership override
nodes.rationale: Business-logic ALLOW override layered on top of identity-access evaluateAccess (call it first, then fall back to ownership check only when the sole deny reason is default_deny) rather than a new cross-module primitive.

nodes.label: Data Lifecycle module README
nodes.rationale: System Foundation module (ADR-0037): a module-contributed high-volume-table registry plus a safe lifecycle engine (dry-run, bounded archive/purge, legal holds) that never writes another module's table (ADR-0013 no-shared-table-write).

nodes.label: LegalHoldGuardPort cross-module enforcement
nodes.rationale: A delegated adopter's own purge function is the real enforcement point: it takes a LegalHoldGuardPort and skips its DELETE when the descriptor is held; the adapter is wired at composition roots to avoid a forbidden circular import (ADR-0011).
